cat > slug.py <<'EOF'
import re


def slugify(title: str) -> str:
    return re.sub(r'\s+', '-', title.lower())
EOF
cat >> tests/test_slug.py <<'EOF'


def test_slugify_single_space_becomes_one_hyphen():
    assert slugify('a b') == 'a-b'


def test_slugify_collapses_long_space_run():
    assert slugify('a     b') == 'a-b'


def test_slugify_collapses_non_space_whitespace_runs():
    assert slugify('a\t\tb') == 'a-b'
    assert slugify('a\n\nb') == 'a-b'


def test_slugify_collapses_mixed_whitespace_run():
    assert slugify('a \t\n b') == 'a-b'


def test_slugify_collapses_runs_at_the_edges():
    assert slugify('  a  ') == '-a-'


def test_slugify_collapses_each_run_separately():
    assert slugify('a  b   c') == 'a-b-c'


def test_slugify_lowercases_every_letter():
    assert slugify('Hello WORLD  Foo') == 'hello-world-foo'
EOF

git add slug.py tests/test_slug.py && git commit -qm "Collapse whitespace runs in slugify
